# Workspace Instructions

- This is a Vite + React + TypeScript daily Korean practice website.
- Keep interface text in Traditional Chinese and learning content focused on everyday conversation, not exams.
- Shadowing audio uses browser Korean speech synthesis when available; microphone recordings stay local and must include unsupported-device fallbacks.
- Store practice progress and favorites locally unless the user requests a backend.
- Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint` after meaningful changes.
